items.title: Convicted murderer who escaped through Tennessee prison fence is captured, officials say
items.brief: A convicted murderer who escaped a Tennessee jail was apprehended in Missouri and brought back into custody, officials said –– nine days after he breached the prison fence and drove off in a stolen truck.

items.title: Trump says US is cutting off aid to Israel at year’s end because ‘they don’t need it’
items.brief: President Donald Trump said Tuesday that the United States is cutting off $4 billion in aid to Israel at the end of the year because “they don’t need it.”

items.title: Bomb threats on flights in Europe cause disruption, no devices found
items.brief: At least seven flights and a cruise ship in Europe received bomb threats on Tuesday, causing disruption at airports although no devices were discovered.

items.title: Spanish soccer player Jesús de Miguel dies after on-pitch collision
items.brief: Soccer player Jesús de Miguel has died after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match on Monday, his club CD Tenerife has said.

items.title: Child in New York dies after contracting measles, the state’s first such death in 30 years
items.brief: A child in Lewis County, New York, has died after contracting measles, officials announced Monday.
